title: Quiet warehouse schema falsely reported as stalled schedule
answers: Why is a quiet warehouse schema marked as stalled with REPAIRED_SCHEMA_ERROR?
How does stalled_schema_queryset check sync activity without failing on zero-batch runs?
Why was an external data schema schedule repaired if syncs never stopped running?
body:
Symptom: A quiet data warehouse schema is reported as stalled with REPAIRED_SCHEMA_ERROR despite scheduled syncs completing successfully.
Root cause: `products/warehouse_sources/backend/stalled_schedules.py:stalled_schema_queryset` evaluated staleness against `last_synced_at`, which zero-batch runs intentionally do not update.
Fix pattern: Determine last execution time in SQL using `Greatest(last_synced_at, last_full_run)` to distinguish inactive sources from stopped schedules.
Constraints: When casting JSON timestamp fields in Postgres, filter with an offset-aware ISO regex (`_AWARE_ISO_TIMESTAMP`) before casting to prevent parse errors and session timezone drift.
applies: Detecting stalled schedules or querying last run times for external data schemas in warehouse sources.
